{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check how many rows per patient
print(f"Distribution of sample_seq per patient_id:\n{data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count().value_counts()}")

# Check assay_batch units
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check for missing values
print(f"Missing values per column:\n{data.isnull().sum()}")

# Check baseline biomarker values
print(f"Range of biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].min()} to {data['biomarker_baseline'].max()}")

# Check final biomarker values
print(f"Range of biomarker_final: {data['biomarker_final'].min()} to {data['biomarker_final'].max()}")"}
